subject: England beat Spain 3-2 in Madrid, ending Spain's 43-match run without a competitive defeat
title: England end Spain's 43-game run

lines.vo: Forty-three games unbeaten. Then England popped round to Madrid.
Harry Kane scored a penalty. Ezri Konsa and Ben White added two more. Three-nil, in Madrid.
Then Elliot Anderson was sent off for fouling Lamine Yamal. England made it interesting, as ever.
Oyarzabal and Nico Williams pulled it back. Yamal set up both. He is nineteen. At nineteen, I could barely boil pasta.
Tuchel called it the best result of his England tenure. Spain's first home defeat in over four years.
